title: Otori Emu — Enter Count Otori!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning, Emu.
As peppy as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Peppy...?
Actually, it looks to me like she just heard some good news.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa♪ My brothers gave me tickets to the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Phoenix Bridal Fair?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a convention where you can look at and even try on all sorts of wedding dresses!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, and they're also supposed to have lots of booths where you can make your own bouquets and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, wedding dresses...?
I'm kinda interested since that could come in handy later for a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, when is this fair taking place?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh, it's on the ticket...
It says this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sorry, but I already have a prior engagement.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I'm also going somewhere with my family...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's too bad. I was hoping we could go together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're sorry...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Can you think of anyone else who you think would be interested?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyone else...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, yeah! I think Honami said that she likes to make her own clothes and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll ask her the next time we're at school♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Actually, Emu, if you don't mind...
Can you tell me more about the fair as a whole?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I would also like to know!
Since we won't be able to go, I'd like to hear all about what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've mentioned so far that you can try on dresses and make your own bouquets...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Oh, gimme one sec!
I jotted down everything my brothers told me earlier...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... They're gonna have all these dresses made by famous designers, and even some by amateurs who won a contest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're also gonna have tiaras, necklaces, bracelets and a bunch of other accessories there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's even supposed to be this one booth where you can have custom ones made!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, this is starting to sound like a pretty big fair...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it would've been nice to see all these dresses and accessories. We could've used them as reference for future costumes and outfits.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'll make sure to take a bunch of pictures! I'm supposed to go have a look around with my brothers for work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, please do. That would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure thing♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! I wanted to ask you guys for some advice about the event for the fitting area!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want our advice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I just remembered something my brothers said after looking at my notepad.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “The fitting area won't draw in many people if it's just a place where you can try on dresses. It needs to feel more special.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “As such, we're looking to have some sort of activity available at the chapel. If you have any fun ideas, we'd like to hear them.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this is supposed to be a really big convention, right? Are you sure they want to use our ideas? We're just high schoolers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Surely they've thought this through, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. They wish to hear from us, which I suspect can only mean...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're hoping to put on some kind of show, yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! Yeah, that's right!
How'd you know, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When they first told me about this bridal fair, I immediately began telling them about what you did with the flash mob at that wedding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
If it's a show they want, this is right up our alley.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We should be able to come up with something good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, is there anything we need to be mindful of?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, can you tell us more about the actual wedding area?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, the amount of time to be allotted. How long will each group have in the limelight?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Just gimme a sec to look through my notes☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a wedding, so having to overcome an obstacle or solve a problem together may be nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, how about disposing of someone who barges in to stop the wedding from proceeding?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
D-Dispose...?!
That sounds like a bit much. I'm sure they have their reasons...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? Then... What if we made this person an overly intrusive vampire?

rows.Speaker: Nene & Emu
rows.Line: A vampire?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a bit fantastical... But it may work given that the show needs to be easily understood in a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See what I mean? If anything, it's probably better to do something that seems a little wild or crazy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, that...actually kind of came together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In terms of moving the story along, we made it so the guests simply need to do as the staff says. That way, anyone will be able to participate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup☆ This sounds like a lot of fun♪ I'll make sure to tell my brothers!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great. And feel free to ask us if you think you need any more help!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you guys so much!
I promise to make it a super duper fun show that everyone's gonna love!
